app.name: Timed Memories
app.summary: Shows a photo full-screen with its age as a caption: the months and days from a reference date to the day it was taken.
app.reference_date_hint: The birthday used to calculate the subject's age, as year-month-day, e.g. 2025-06-15.
app.button_action_hint: A script or automation to run, typed as script.<name> or automation.<name>. Leave empty to hide the button.
app.button_icon_hint: Any Material Design Icons name Tessera has installed, written with or without mdi:, or a supported five-digit hexadecimal codepoint. While it is empty or names an unavailable icon, a default (skip-next) stands in.
